about: Renovating an apartment in a high-rise on Antonovycha Street

In a high-rise, an apartment gets lots of light and views, and with them some tasks: sun protection, air conditioning without draughts, curtains or blinds that do not block the view. We think these solutions through in the design project, not after you move in.

Logistics in a high-rise is a topic of its own. Materials go up the service lift at agreed hours, and large-format slabs and worktops are checked against the lift dimensions in advance. We remove construction waste ourselves without leaving it in the lobbies.
A business-class management company usually has renovation rules: hours for noisy works, protection of lifts and common areas. We study them before starting and follow them.
For reference: address — 136–138 Antonovycha St. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.
